contract: implementation-checklist.md: Recreate all five Eleventra reference pages in React/Vite/Tailwind, retaining typography, original content/assets, section order, reference breakpoints and interactions.

accessibility.evidence: Axe WCAG A/AA reported zero violations on all five routes. Field labels/errors, first-invalid and detail-heading focus, mobile Escape restoration, Tab and gold input ring verified. Full screen-reader audit not performed; incomplete axe checks documented.

responsive.evidence: All five routes at all five requested sizes have no horizontal document overflow and one h1. Homepage screenshots visually reviewed for desktop, laptop, tablet and both mobile sizes; route and navigation stack as intended.

loading.evidence: Observed lazy-route Loading status while navigation modules load.

empty.evidence: Unmatched career query displayed No careers found and Clear filters restored results.

error.evidence: Submitting blank contact form exposed four linked errors and focused student name; corrections cleared errors.

partial.evidence: Testimonial, contact and policy placeholders explicitly retained and labeled from the source.

success.evidence: Valid dummy form submission reset values, focused preview confirmation and explicitly stated enquiries are not sent.

permission.reason: The reference and recreation have no authentication, permission-dependent workflow, or privileged browser capability.

renderedEvidence.observation: Rendered homepage reviewed: typography, gutters, hero wrapping and route layout fit the viewport; no horizontal overflow. Desktop/mobile compared with reference captures excluding the Claude toolbar.
